description: This Java source file defines the `PlatformRequestLog` class, an immutable data object used for logging platform API requests, capturing details such as request method, URL, parameters, and timing information.

classes.name: PlatformRequestLog
classes.description: Immutable data object representing platform API request used for logging and debugging. Contains fields for request start time, total time, HTTP method, URL, and parameters. Includes a static factory method to create an instance from a StopWatch and HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a PlatformRequestLog instance from a StopWatch and HttpServletRequest, capturing timing and request details, excluding sensitive parameters like 'password' and '_'.
